description: This file contains functions and types related to managing session depth information, including reading session stores, normalizing session data, and resolving session depth based on session keys and store data.

methods.name: normalizeSpawnDepth
methods.description: Normalizes a value to a spawn depth number if valid, otherwise undefined.

methods.name: normalizeSessionKey
methods.description: Trims and validates a session key string.

methods.name: readSessionStore
methods.description: Reads and parses a session store JSON file from a given path.

methods.name: buildKeyCandidates
methods.description: Builds possible session key variants based on raw key and configuration.

methods.name: findEntryBySessionId
methods.description: Finds a session depth entry in the store matching a session ID.

methods.name: resolveEntryForSessionKey
methods.description: Resolves a session depth entry for a given session key, using cache and store data.
